label: Cursor
query: select key as id, json_extract(value, $.tokenCount.inputTokens) as input_tokens, json_extract(value, $.tokenCount.outputTokens) as output_tokens, json_extract(value, $.tokenCount.totalUsedTokens) as total, json_extract(value, $.createdAt) as ts from cursorDiskKV where key like bubbleId:% and (json_extract(value, $.tokenCount.inputTokens) is not null or json_extract(value, $.tokenCount.outputTokens) is not null)
caveat: Windows/Linux 路径见 CodeBurn cursor.ts；bubbleId 含换行的工具行应过滤（driver 阶段）。
